decisions.reason: “that very” already carries 바로 그; adding “same” is redundant padding.
“own blood” and parallel “inheritor” render 혈육이자…이은 more vividly than “blood relative, had inherited.”
SOL’s “sighed inwardly” is better English, but “someone” and “only just” weaken 놈 and 간신히.
decisions.replacement: When the Third Young Master first accepted Lee Seogeun’s challenge to a duel, Wipeng had sighed inwardly. *What nerve did a guy who had barely escaped third-rate think he had?*

decisions.reason: 지랄한다 is him talking/acting shit; SOL’s “what a load of shit” judges the situation instead.
“using polite speech without fail” keeps 꼬박꼬박 존댓말; SOL’s “speaking politely all the time” loosens both.
Keep 깨달음이 왔다 as “dawned on him”; the 우화등선 line belongs in H007.
decisions.replacement: At the time, Wipeng had wondered if the man had gone insane. But when he heard today that the Third Young Master had laid a hand on the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s cherished jewel, it dawned on him.

decisions.reason: Restores 우화등선할 뻔했다; BASE had flattened it to “died of shock.”
인간 here is proverbial “a person,” not a scientific “human being.”
Drops stacked “bad seed,” keeps the yellow-to-gold sprout joke, and “served the” reads cleaner than “served in.”
직계 as “direct descendant” is natural clan English; “intended to save” matches 구해야겠다는 생각 better than “planning to rescue.”
Delays the beater to recreate 두드려 팬다 / 진태경이 이소군을.
“By Jin Taekyung.” is the delayed-subject punchline; BASE’s lone name is leftover.
Names Taekyung so “he” cannot snap to Lee Seogeun after the inversion.
SOL inflates 제법 to “remarkably,” drops 쯤, and turns 굴러먹다 into unsupported “fighting.”
Natural “in a day or two”; SOL’s “through a day or two of effort” is calqued.
“defied the natural order” is tighter for 순리를 거스르는 than “had gone against.”
주변 is the scene around the duel, not only around Wipeng.
Preserves the 봤나 rhetorical (“would you look at”) instead of a generic “what a bunch.”
Captures 아랫것들까지 and 행패를 부리다; BASE’s “cause such a scene” is weaker and incomplete.
“could bear it no longer… when—” is cleaner English for 나서려던 순간이었다.
십여 is about ten, not “more than ten”; “gust” is extra, and “some ten” is stilted US English.
decisions.replacement: The wind blew, and about ten teeth flew through the air.

decisions.reason: 입가로 is the corner of the mouth; SOL drops it.
Attempted speech should be quoted, but 어버 is a buh-sound, not “Whuh.”
“speak properly” matches 발음; “slapped” is exact for 아구창을 갈겼다.
다시 자리로 돌아와 is returning to his seat, not merely sitting back down.
Interrupted warning about consequences; “this could cause trouble” fits 문제가 생길 better as spoken English.
“gazed” fits 바라보며 with shining eyes better than flat “looked.”
Cuts repeated “martial arts” / “fight anyone” without losing 싸울 일도 없었고, 싸우고 싶지도.
실전 is actual combat, not a “battle.”
상당한 의미 is “meant a great deal”; “incredibly valuable” intensifies.
“folded like a shrimp” naturalizes 새우처럼 꺾였다; “squarely” is fine for 직격.
Drops redundant “in his hands”; “tore another scream” matches 비명이 터져 나왔다.
Present-tense thought matches 먹혀? and the live Level contrast.
Restores 현실로 치자면, which BASE omitted.
Lets the stat list stand as its own beat, matching 근력, 체력, 민첩.
Isolates the three stats as in the source fragment.
Ends on the weaker-opponent clause so “But I was different” can punch.
Gives 나는 달랐다 its own line as a turn.
“No doubt about it” is spoken certainty for 분명히, matching MC voice.
다짐 is determination/resolution, not “a decision.”
Keeps the spear discard; the 맨몸 clause is rewritten in H042.
Naturalizes 둘 다 무기가 없는 맨몸 간의 격돌; BASE’s “clash between two unarmed bodies” is translationese.
불길이 쏟아졌다 is fire pouring from the eyes, not merely blazing in them.
Needed split so the trip is not duplicated; anger line remains faithful.
“hooked” matches 다리를 걸어; “straddled” sets up the full mount better than “climbed onto.”
Looking “into” the eyes is the natural collocation for 눈동자를 내려다보며.
“Ever heard of” matches casual 들어 봤냐.
휘저었 is vigorous whipping to dodge, not a “no” head-shake.
SOL drops 가리지 않고 and 끝없이 몸을 뒤틀고.
애초에 is “original,” not “entire.”
Spoken equivalent of 적당 선에서 멈춰야 했다 without changing the limit.
Restores 약간의 in “a little worried”; BASE’s “Concerned” overstates it.
약간의 어지러움 is a slight fragment; SOL invents a “wave” and replaces 뚝뚝 떨어졌다 with “fell.”
States the graze directly; “the result of” is a Korean 결과였다 calque.
순간적으로 is the last instant, not an unsupported “instinctively.”
Restores 그 틈을 타 (“seizing the opportunity”), which BASE omitted.
Keep linking “he was” and 놈 as “guy”; SOL’s “someone” and “this badly” soften and intensify.
decisions.replacement: Of course he was. He probably hadn’t imagined that a guy like me—no, a guy like Jin Taekyung—would humiliate him like this.

decisions.reason: 회심의 일격…무효로 as “best shot had come to nothing” is idiomatic MC narration.
Restores omitted 친절하게; “possessed” is acceptable for 홀린 듯이.
왜! 어떻게! are outbursts; SOL’s question marks flatten the shout.
핏발 선 눈으로 is “with bloodshot eyes”; “shouted through” is a bad collocation.
Keep 왜! as an outburst; keep SOL’s “debauched, lazy trash” for 방탕하고 게으른 쓰레기.
decisions.replacement: I honed my skills for ten years. So why! Why am I losing to someone like you? To debauched, lazy trash like you!

decisions.reason: Splits 공감했다 from the following fragments; “sympathize with him” is enough for 심정에 공감.
Keeps 노력이 배신당하는 기분 / 허무와 공허 as punchy fragments.
무뎌질지언정 is concessive (“might dull”), and 박탈감 as “having been robbed” is stronger than dictionary “deprivation.”
Gives 나는 결국 받아들였었다 its own close.
이제 그만 needs “now”; SOL drops it.
Keeps 그 말을 들은; English “eyes rolled” reads as contempt, not 눈이 뒤집혔다 rage.
Participial gather-and-shoot is tighter for 끌어모은…쏘아졌다.
분명히 말했다 is “told you clearly,” not an inferred “warned.”
Leads with 바람이 갈라지는 소리, matching source order; SOL buries the sound.
봤던 is “I had seen,” not “he had shown me.”
발등 is “the top of” the foot (instep); “on top of” is vaguer.
박혀 든다 is sinking/embedding, not punching through the floor.
정권 is a knuckle strike; “straight punch” is an extra boxing specification.
Do not split off “perfectly”; 제대로 is “cleanly” inside the following sentence.
Keeps 잔뜩 집중시킨 한 방; SOL’s “packed” drops the concentrated single blow.
“flew wide” is a stronger, still faithful 크게 떠졌다.
쓰러지는 is in progress; he has not finished collapsing before the kick.
Isolates the slow-motion 눈에 들어왔다 beat.
Present participle matches the ongoing slow-motion seeing.
“went sailing” is more idiomatic for 훨훨 날았다 than “body went flying.”
Separates 모두가 그 장면을 지켜봤다 from the name list.
Name-list cadence matches 진위경, 위팽. …무사들.
그리고 나도 is “And me, too,” not “Even me.”
미동도 하지 않았다 is “didn’t so much as twitch”; “hitting the ground” fits 쿠웅.
옮겨진 gazes have already shifted; SOL’s “as…shifted” makes it simultaneous.
기감 파악 is detect, not a new “assess”; keep established “Level up!” casing.
Notifications “rang out like” fireworks is the right verb for 축포처럼 들렸다.
Splits 이빨이 몽땅 from the 세상에 gasp; “every one” carries 몽땅.
Gives 세상에, 도대체 어떤 놈이 its own interrupted beat.
Need 그때, but 근엄한 얼굴로 is a solemn expression, not merely “solemnly patted.”
decisions.replacement: Just then, Jin Wikyung patted me on the shoulder with a solemn expression.

decisions.reason: 잘해 줬어 is casual “did better”; “performed” is too formal.
Cleaner word order for 그 잠깐 사이에; “a man” is natural for the known male victim.
Makes today’s performance itself the 홍복, matching the Korean syntax.
둘러보며 말을 이었다 is simultaneous “as he continued,” not “before.”
호의적 is favorable, not “friendly.”
소설에서 보면 is novels in general, not a specific set.
하하하 and the unsmiling eyes are Wikyung’s; the line is “answer me,” not a third party’s “answer him.”
까지 더해지니 as “combined with” and “scene straight out of” match 호러 무비가 따로 없다.
Tags Wipeng so the agreement is not misread as Wikyung’s after the horror-smile beat.
위팽의 여론 조작까지 더해지자 is his manipulation added to the mix, not him “joining a campaign.”
“enforced through a show of force” is clearer for 무력 시위에 의한 부정 투표.
건 is a “matter,” and the 명분 belongs to the sect (“them”), not only to him.
“all well and good” / “profited” idiomatically render 그걸로 좋고 and 이득을 얻는다면.
Splits the half-cripple rumor as its own counterfactual, with “had turned” after failure.
Leaves the humiliation line as the rumor’s content, matching the source break.
범재 is mediocre talent, not merely “ordinary.”
항산검문의 차남 does not name the Sect Leader; admiration moves to H110.
decisions.replacement: The second son of the Mount Heng Sword Sect. A promising young martial artist. A first-rate swordsman.

decisions.reason: Gives 선망의 대상 its own trailing beat in natural English.
“brought to his knees by” is the English for 폭력 앞에서 무릎을 꿇고; “shattered” is tight for 박살 났다.
이 마차조차도 is “this carriage.”
Same 불길이 쏟아졌다 image as H043: poured, not blazed.
차오르는 분 is rising fury; SOL drops 차오르는.
“The carriage stopped” is the natural English for 움직임을 멈췄다.
거칠게 소리쳤다 as “harshly” avoids “roughly”’s other English sense.
다시 출발해 requires “again”; SOL drops 다시.
미간 is the spot between the eyebrows, later the needle’s insertion point.
Echoes 출발? as a mocking question, which BASE flattens.
누구냐 is shouted at an unseen speaker; “Who are you?” assumes a visible addressee too early.
목이 타는 듯 아프다 is hurt as if on fire; SOL drops the simile and 아프다.
“afterward” is the natural adverb for 다음에 가는 걸로.
그게 무슨 is truncated; BASE over-completes with “mean.”
“no longer than a few blinks” is cleaner English for 눈 몇 번 깜빡일 만한 시간.
거세게 타올랐다 modifies the flaring, not the pain as “violent pain.”
복면을 쓴 is “wearing a mask.”
The blood replaces the voice he tried to use; “his voice” is the right English.
Keeps 싱긋 as “smiled brightly” and 회수했다 as “retrieved,” not a plain pull.
Clearer gloss: “someone is a hopeless case” and “not to imply that he was born rich.”
